pageProps.title: Daily Dose of Sunshine Season 1 (2023)
pageProps.review: This drama is a heavy-weight work that removes prejudice against mental illness and makes us look back at ourselves, leaving deep resonance and much to think about beyond light healing.
pageProps.content:
## Review I thought it was a light healing work just by looking at the title, but it's a work with a weight that is by no means light. It removes prejudice against mental illness, makes us look back at ourselves, and leaves much to think about.
Ambrosia
